Jules (sales): Heads-up: Prospect 'BrightGrid' requested a 4-week POC. Needs hosted API keys, a small Dedicated pool (burst 35 rps), VPC peering, and a billing project with spend cap + starter credits. Can billing spin this up by end of week?
Nora (billing): Yep. I need org_id, billing contact, requested spend cap, starter credits, allowed models, and quotas (tokens/day, rpm). Hard-stop requires a signed addendum.
Jules (sales): Org: brightgrid-55, billing@brightgrid.com. They requested $7,500 cap and $2,500 credits. Models: 13B-quantized only. Quota: 600k tokens/day, 300 rpm. Regions: us-east-1 primary. Hard-stop: yes (they will sign).
Ken (solutions): For dedicated: 2x A10G-equivalent recommended for stable 35rps. Block 70B variants in routing policy. Set routing: preferred dedicated, fallback to hosted tiny models.
Raja (infra): For peering I need their VPC CIDR, desired peer subnet, and ingress ports. Peering ETA 1-3 business days after we have CIDR + signed AUP. If they want CMEK, provide KMS ARN (security review).
DevEx Bot: Quick CLI snippet to create temp project for devs: `redwoodctl project create --org brightgrid-55 --name brightgrid-poc-temp --spend-cap=7500 --credits=2500 --models="13b-q" --quota-tokens=600000 --quota-rpm=300 --regions="us-east-1"` then `redwoodctl keys issue --project <id> --type ephemeral --ttl 14d`. Ephemeral keys are recommended.
Nora (billing): Send the JSON payload and signed addendum here and I'll provision the billing project and enable hard-stop. I'll also create ticket #POC-5501 to track.
Jules (sales): I'll get the signed doc and CIDR today and post back. Thanks! :thumbsup:
